steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: Navigate to the Desk page, which displays research readiness data and pilot study information.
steps.point_out: The page loads with 'Playbook Signals' as the main heading. Below are collapsible sections for Microscope Readiness, Scout Ledger, and other research tools.

steps.title: Expand Microscope Readiness to view corpus data
steps.narration: Click the Microscope Readiness section to see the corpus totals and readiness figures. This data now loads faster on repeat views thanks to improved caching.
steps.point_out: The section expands to show a 'Corpus Totals' table with values like distinct symbol-days, datasets, RTH minutes, and session-equivalents.

steps.title: Scroll to the Referee Registry section
steps.narration: Scroll down to find the Referee Registry section. This section shows the legacy readiness metric and pilot-study strategy information.
steps.point_out: You see section headers for Referee Registry, Referee Adjudications, and Referee Runs. The page structure remains unchanged from previous iterations.

steps.title: View the disclosure about the legacy readiness metric
steps.narration: The Referee Registry now displays a clarification message. This explains that the legacy metric may include withheld Rapid Microscope shards and must not be used as the canonical readiness count.
steps.point_out: Inside the Strategy Family block, you see the new disclosure text: 'Legacy Referee readiness metric — seal-unaware in the Rapid Microscope era. It may include withheld/unexposed Rapid-Microscope shards and must not be used as the canonical Rapid-Microscope readiness count.' This text appears beside the Datasets and Trades figures.

steps.title: Expand Scout Ledger to verify pilot studies
steps.narration: Scroll back up and open the Scout Ledger section. It shows the pilot-study families and their trial variants, now rendered with consolidated internal wiring.
steps.point_out: The section displays 'Ledger chain verification: ok' followed by pilot-study family rows. Each row shows the family name, root ID, and variants tried.

steps.title: Expand Walk-Forward section to verify fold integrity
steps.narration: Click the Walk-Forward section to view the diagnostic fold results. This section demonstrates the chronological and integrity checks that run during the analysis.
steps.point_out: The Walk-Forward section shows fold specifications and verification status. You see the section displays cleanly with no errors.

steps.title: Expand Validation Vault to view sealed tranche
steps.narration: Open the Validation Vault section to see the sealed-at dates and exposure status. This section records which datasets have been sealed for validation.
steps.point_out: The Validation Vault shows registered datasets with their sealed status. All sections render correctly with no blank panels or errors.

steps.title: Verify Referee Adjudications is ready
steps.narration: Expand the Referee Adjudications section. It tracks hypotheses registered for evaluation and remains empty until pilot studies are fully registered.
steps.point_out: The Referee Adjudications section displays 'No hypotheses registered.' This is the expected state for the current test corpus.
